headline: Think fast.
Score more.
caption:
Faster correct answers earn more points.
Every second counts.

headline: Your interests.
Your quiz.
caption:
30 topics, mixed quizzes and
over 21,000 questions to explore.

headline: Challenge now.
They can play later.
caption:
Follow your rivals. Send a challenge.
You don’t have to be online together.

headline: Know more.
Level up.
caption:
Earn XP and build a separate level
in each of your favourite topics.

headline: Find your place.
Then climb.
caption:
Compete in topic leagues,
this month and across all time.

headline: How far
can you go?
caption:
Keep scoring until a wrong answer or timeout.
Chase the top of the standings.

headline: Make it
a game night.
caption:
Private tournaments for 2–8 friends.
Everyone picks a home topic.

headline: Win coins.
Wear your badge.
caption:
Finish in a public tournament’s top three
to earn coins and a profile badge.

headline: Keep the
rivalry going.
caption:
Follow players, compare your head-to-head
record and discover shared interests.

headline: One more
round?
caption:
See who won, review your answers
and start a rematch.
